title: Emit the Travel Pace and Ability Scores and Modifiers core-rules tables
description: eshyra-0m9.22 recovered the section prose that resumes below excluded table captions (rule:speed now carries the Travel Pace / Forced March / Mounts and Vehicles prose; rule:ability-scores-and-modifiers its modifier-arithmetic prose), but two core-rules tables behind those captions still emit NO table record: Travel Pace (p84, columns Pace / Distance per Minute / Hour / Day + effect column) and Ability Scores and Modifiers (p76, score-range to modifier). Both captions are in TABLE_CAPTION_LEAF_TITLES (excluded from the rule kind) and have no parseTables reconstruction rule, so the row data is dropped entirely. The core-rules Combat 'Size Categories' table (p92, Size/Space) also emits nothing, but the Monsters-chapter table:size-categories (p254) is a strict superset (adds Examples), so review whether p92 needs its own record or a documented intentional omission. Expected behavior: add anchored reconstruction rules in parseTables.ts (likely header-row anchors since captions repeat in body prose), add the names to EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_TABLE_NAMES, regenerate, and extend srdGeneratedPack.test.ts pinned table assertions. Files: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseTables.ts, index.ts, packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts, packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
close_reason: Emitted both core-rules tables behind excluded captions via header-row anchors in parseTables.ts (Score Modifier / 'Pace Distance Traveled per . . .'; both unique document-wide since the captions repeat as section headings). table:ability-scores-and-modifiers (p76, 16 rows, fail-closed) and table:travel-pace (p84, 3 multi-line rows with units folding, bounded by Difficult Terrain, fail-closed). p92 Size Categories resolved as documented intentional omission: Space cells identical to the p254 superset table (adds Examples). Pack regenerated (27->29 tables, diff exactly the 2 new records), verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exact match, audit clean, full suite green (1439 passed). PR: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/192
